title: Pulley, which offers cap table management software, says it will cease operations after December 8; it had raised $50M+ from investors, including Founders Fund (Melia Robinson/Business Insider)
summary: Melia Robinson / Business Insider: Pulley, which offers cap table management software, says it will cease operations after December 8; it had raised $50M+ from investors, including Founders Fund — Pulley, a software that startups rely on to track their funding, is shutting down after seven years.
